description: Family-owned freight forwarder with 140 trucks. Tours are still planned in Excel and delivery notes are on paper. Opened a second depot near Hanover in 2026 and is hiring dispatchers.
Sheet metal and welding supplier for machine builders. Production planning runs on an ERP system introduced in 2004. Management announced plans to double laser-cutting capacity by 2027.
Producer of chilled ready meals for supermarket chains. Quality documentation is kept in paper binders. Retail customers now require digital traceability for every batch.
Injection moulding of plastic parts for the automotive and household sectors. Orders arrive by email and fax and are typed in manually. A new managing director took over in early 2026.
Wholesaler for building materials with eight branches. Stock levels are reconciled once a month by hand. Struggles with rising stock-outs and has started looking for a new inventory system.
